Synthesis Methods.description: The specific method name (e.g., Solvothermal synthesis, Microwave-assisted synthesis, Schiff-base condensation). NOT 'Complexation' or 'Suzuki coupling' unless it forms the polymer network.

Activation.description: Post-synthesis purification of the SOLID powder. Includes filtration, washing solvents, Soxhlet extraction, and drying conditions.

Solvent Composition.description: Names of solvents used in the synthesis mixture.

Solvent Volume.description: Total volume or individual volumes (e.g., '2 mL total' or '1 mL mesitylene, 1 mL dioxane').

Solvent Additive.description: Additives like acetic acid, aqueous HCl, modulation agents.

Reaction Concentration.description: Amounts of ALL reactants (monomers). Format: 'Name: Amount (mg/mmol)'.

Catalyst.description: Catalyst used to drive the polymerization (e.g., '6M aqueous acetic acid').
